description: Box Office Product — everything a managed product does for its operator, such as Direct, in one call: creates the tenant the operator registers and reports it ready, answers whether a person may take a seat and whether a tenant is read-only, and reports who was active, built on Cratis Arc and Chron…
Distributed coordination on DynamoDB for DynaSharp: a lease on a named lock with fencing tokens, after the semantics of the DynamoDB Lock Client, and leader election on top of it.
